# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.author.bio }}. Research in post-training and alignment for language and vision models, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, reasoning evaluation, and multilingual and multimodal models.

## When this site is useful

This is an individual researcher’s website. Use the biography and professional profile for background, the publications page for the full paper list, and the service page for academic roles. Research notes link to original papers; use those publication records for authorship, methods, and results.

## Machine-readable publications

- [Publication catalog]({{ site.url }}/publications.json): All {{ site.data.publications.size }} listed papers with full authorship, site-curated research topics, verified DOI identifiers where available, and source-attributed abstracts, in JSON-LD.
- [Research and publication text]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt): The same bibliography and source-attributed abstracts in a single text file.

## Machine-readable workshops

- [Workshop catalog]({{ site.url }}/workshops.json): Workshop and challenge-organizer roles, conference editions, and sourced overviews where available. Dates are included only when published by the workshop.
- [Full research and service text]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt): Workshop overviews and role-source links alongside the publication catalog.

## Website

- [About Hitesh]({{ site.url }}/): Biography, current role, and research interests.
- [Publications]({{ site.url }}/publications/): Full publication list with links to their original publication records.
- [Projects]({{ site.url }}/projects/): Work on enterprise generative AI, coding assistants, vision, and document intelligence at Oracle.
- [Professional profile]({{ site.url }}/cv/): Role, education, research, and professional profiles.
- [Talks]({{ site.url }}/talks/): Invited talks.
- [Service]({{ site.url }}/service/): Community service and open research contributions.
- [Awards]({{ site.url }}/awards/): Recognition and awards.
- [News]({{ site.url }}/news/): Dated research updates.
